create_transformers_base_model: create a vLLM model instance from a HuggingFace Transformers model using the Base backend class
load_model_weights: load pretrained weights into a transformers-based vLLM model using the AutoWeightsLoader with HF-to-vLLM name mapping
replace_model_layers: replace nn.Linear, nn.Conv2d, and RMSNorm layers in a transformers model with vLLM tensor-parallel equivalents
run_model_forward: run a forward pass on a transformers-based vLLM model with input_ids, positions, and attention instances
create_attention_instances: create vLLM Attention instances for KV cache allocation from a transformers model config
